description:
## Why

PKIX-amgn.8 demonstrates the catalog-paired-with-Rust-Lint pattern. This bead lands one concrete Lint impl, the startup invariant that catches drift between registered Lints and the catalog, and the divergences.md scaffolding.

## What

### One Lint impl

Pick a high-value, easy-to-implement zlint rule (e.g. `e_basic_constraints_not_critical` — basicConstraints MUST be critical when present in CA certs, RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 + CA/B Forum BR 7.1.2). Implement in pkix-lint-cabf/src/lints/basic_constraints_not_critical.rs:

```rust
use pkix_lint::{Lint, Finding, Severity};

pub struct BasicConstraintsNotCriticalLint;

impl Lint for BasicConstraintsNotCriticalLint {
    fn id(&self) -> &'static str { "e_basic_constraints_not_critical" }

    fn check_cert(&self, cert: &Certificate) -> Vec<Finding> {
        // walk cert.tbs.extensions for OID 2.5.29.19 (basicConstraints)
        // if present and !is_critical and is_ca: produce Finding
    }
}
```

The Lint's metadata methods (title, description, citation, etc.) delegate to crate::catalog::cabf_br_tls().get("e_basic_constraints_not_critical") and return those values. Per PKIX-9vnx.6, this is the Lint-as-Control pattern.

### Startup invariant

In pkix-lint-cabf/src/lib.rs:

```rust
pub fn all_cabf_br_tls_lints() -> Vec<Box<dyn Lint>> {
    vec![Box::new(BasicConstraintsNotCriticalLint), /* ... */]
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod invariant_tests {
    #[test]
    fn every_registered_lint_has_catalog_entry() {
        let catalog = crate::catalog::cabf_br_tls();
        for lint in crate::all_cabf_br_tls_lints() {
            assert!(catalog.get(lint.id()).is_some(),
                "registered Lint '{}' has no matching Control in vendored catalog",
                lint.id());
        }
    }
}
```

This catches the case where a Lint is added/renamed but the catalog wasn't refreshed.

### divergences.md placeholder

pkix-lint-cabf/divergences.md:
```
# Divergences from zlint

This file tracks places where pkix-lint-cabf's interpretation of a CA/B Forum BR rule intentionally differs from zlint's implementation, and why.

Each entry should record:
- Catalog Control ID
- Brief description of the divergence
- Rationale (link to bd issue, ballot discussion, spec disagreement, etc.)
- Date and reviewer

## Current divergences

(none yet — placeholder)
```

## Acceptance

- [ ] One Lint impl pairing with a catalog Control ID, demonstrating the pattern.
- [ ] Lint's check_cert produces a Finding for a known-bad cert; Ok for a known-good cert (unit tests).
- [ ] Lint's metadata methods delegate to the vendored catalog.
- [ ] every_registered_lint_has_catalog_entry test passes.
- [ ] divergences.md placeholder committed.
- [ ] cargo test -p pkix-lint-cabf clean.

## Out of scope

- Implementing all 100+ CABF lints. Pattern is established here; more lints land incrementally in follow-up bds.
- cabf-br-smime / cabf-br-cs catalog pairings (future).

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.8.5.

## Filed by

Decomposed from PKIX-amgn.8 per Mark's 2026-05-11 decisions.
